page.layout: One printed page (page 80), one column of text. Running head at top with page number at left. Below it the heading PARTICIPIVM and a series of paradigm tables in Greek and Latin, each with a small Latin label at the left. Catchword "INDI" at bottom right. Faint show-through from the facing page on the right, not transcribed.
page.notes: Greek forms and endings are copied from the scan as far as legible; the final sign after the stem in several lines is printed as an abbreviation for -ος/-οντος and is read as such, with doubtful accents possible. The right-hand margin shows only faint show-through from the facing page and is not transcribed. The catchword at the foot reads "INDI" followed by a hyphen-like mark.
